summary: walkGraph docstring claims 1-2 hop reachability but only walks 1 hop; also EXPRESSES in the first query pollutes the reachable set with chunk IDs that can never match the second query

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Keeping 1-hop behaviour deliberately, not adding a 2nd hop. One PARALLELS/DERIVES_FROM hop already crosses traditions, and widening to 2 materially grows the candidate set + latency with no eval harness yet to validate quality (harness is a precondition flagged in docs/retriever-hitlist.md). Fix: (1) extract HOP_DEPTH=1 constant + loop so depth is a single named knob, (2) remove EXPRESSES from the reachability query — it's chunk->concept, pollutes reachable with chunk IDs that never match the 2nd query, and removing it is verified zero-retrieval-loss since seed conceptIds are already in reachable, (3) align docstring with reality.

resolution.note: Extracted HOP_DEPTH=1 + frontier loop so walk depth is a single named knob; removed EXPRESSES from the reachability query (chunk→concept, polluted reachable with chunk IDs — verified zero retrieval loss since seed concepts already seeded into reachable); docstring now says 'within HOP_DEPTH hops (currently 1)'.
